text: Desmond opens EmberStake.sol and writes the first real, working Solidity -- stake and withdraw, wired to the live $EMBER token.
stake pulls $EMBER in with transferFrom, updates stakedBalance and totalStaked first, then calls out to the token contract last.
withdraw checks the caller's balance, decrements stakedBalance and totalStaked, then sends $EMBER back with transfer.
Both functions emit the events the indexer already depends on -- Staked and Withdrawn -- for real this time.
Next: writing claimRewards and the rewards accounting logic that actually pays stakers in ETH.
